parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
In your own words, explain why there has been a dramatic increase in the number of journeys
being made by air each year.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain how the state of Tonrovia would benefit from airport expansion in the south-east region.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Considering the advantages and at least one disadvantage, explain which one of the options
would be most suitable to increase the runway capacity in Tonrovia.
You should concentrate on your chosen option and not refer to the other options.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Considering three disadvantages and one advantage, explain which one of the two remaining
options would be least suitable to increase the runway capacity in Tonrovia.
You should concentrate on your chosen option and not refer to the other options.
Section B
Read the material for Section B in the insert before answering the questions in Section B.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Summarise the potential problems of autonomous cars, as stated in the first four paragraphs.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
State the meaning of the two following words or phrases as they are used in the material.
You may write the answer in one word or a short phrase.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Why does Mr Musk think a ‘kill switch’ is such an important feature?

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Explain why over-the-air (OTA) software is thought to be a positive development.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Explain the risks of using OTA software.
Do not repeat any material used in 2(a).

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
Explain why some people may prefer to drive a conventional car.
You should consider reasons other than those identified in the material.
